newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Martin says 1 mln new jobs possible.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Martin says 1 mln new jobs possible.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin on Thursday spoke of the possibility of one million jobs in the next four years.

Martin ridiculed Conservative leader Jean Charest for enlisting the support of the University of Toronto Institute for Policy Analysis in claiming one million jobs would be created in over a four-year mandate under his platform.

"The same institute had previously forecast one million new jobs in the same period in any event," he said. "One million jobs. The fact is that that is what we now see in terms of jobs creation, and that is what this government and Canadians are not satisfied about."
Martin's executive assistant, Terrie O'Leary, explained afterwards that the minister concurred with private sector forecasts of one million new jobs over the next four years.
Liberal Prime Minister Jean Chretien is widely expected to call an election sometime this year, perhaps as early as June.
